mapper.select: SELECT sod.shipment_id, item.item_name, sku.id skuId, sku.sku_name, sod.quantity, sod.storage_shelf, sod.unit_price FROM wms_shipment_order_detail sod LEFT JOIN wms_item_sku sku ON sku.id = sod.sku_id LEFT JOIN wms_item item ON item.id = sku.item_id WHERE sod.shipment_id = #{shipmentId}
